reason: This is a protocol for the ongoing BEBOP cohort study describing planned recruitment and methylation analysis, not yet-reported primary data.
Retrospective biobank study directly measures FAM19A4/miR-124-2 promoter methylation in HPV-positive cervical samples to triage patients against cytology, a clinical screening decision.
Single-patient case study integrating scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq with previously published samples has no defined comparison-group design among the five eligible.
Prospective cohort of 357 gastric cancer patients directly measures CDO1/HOPX peritoneal lavage methylation to diagnose and prognosticate micrometastatic dissemination.
International INFORM registry cohort of 162 pediatric DMG tumors is explicitly profiled by DNA methylation analysis and correlated with treatment and outcome.
Retrospective cohort measures autoantibodies (including anti-histone antibody) driving false-positive syphilis serology, not a histone modification or other epigenetic mark.
Case-control study genotypes protamine/transition-protein gene variants by Sanger sequencing, a genetic not epigenetic measurement of sperm chromatin compaction.
Sperm DNA fragmentation index via the chromatin dispersion test measures strand breakage/packaging, explicitly excluded as not an epigenetic mark per the instrument.
Cross-sectional SOEP cohort measures buccal-derived epigenetic clocks (PedBE, CheekAge) and their association with socioeconomic status and health disparities.
Whole-exome sequencing study of endometrial carcinoma reports SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling gene mutations, not a directly measured methylation or histone-modification level.
Two independent meningioma cohorts (195 discovery, 485 validation) use DNA methylation-based deconvolution of CpG sites to predict TAM/TIL infiltration and survival.
Cross-sectional survey of dietitians' guideline use for galactosaemia measures no biological or epigenetic marker at all.
Genome-wide methylation discovery validated by TaqMan assay in independent non-ICB and ICB-treated ccRCC cohorts links FBLN2 promoter methylation to prognosis and immunotherapy response.
Study measures VAMP8 protein/mRNA expression in cervical tissue via IHC/qPCR; ChIP-qPCR is used only mechanistically in cell lines, not as a patient-measured marker.
Cross-sectional Korean cohort of 1940 participants relates cardiovascular-health lifestyle behaviours to five DNA methylation-based epigenetic age acceleration measures.
H3K14 crotonylation reading by YEATS4 is characterized in breast cancer cell lines; the patient survival correlation appears to use YEATS4 expression, not the histone mark measured in humans.
Prospective validation of the MORE antenatal counselling classification system measures inter-rater reliability, not any epigenetic marker.
Retrospective cohort of 80 brainstem glioma cases develops and validates a CSF ctDNA methylation classifier (BSGdiag) for diagnosis, prognosis, and monitoring.
SH-MARA is an enrolling study protocol describing planned genetic/methylation analysis of self-harm risk, with no reported primary results yet.
Retrospective histopathological review of 13 H3 G34-mutant glioma cases at a single centre with no stated comparison group is a case series.
Monocentric cohort of 71 metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma patients directly measures HOXD8/POU4F1 methylated ctDNA and correlates it with tumour volume for disease monitoring.
Case-control study of 20 periodontitis and 20 healthy gingival tissue samples directly measures LINE-1 and gene-specific DNA methylation via bisulfite pyrosequencing after periodontal therapy.
The 'histone acetylation-based' model is built from a 7-gene expression signature associated with HAT activity in GEO/TCGA data, not a directly assayed histone modification.
Cohort of 24 pediatric high-grade glioma tissues versus normal brain measures H3K9me3 by immunohistochemistry and correlates it with survival.
Prospective OPTiMiSE cohort of 116 first-episode psychosis patients profiles paired blood methylomes to predict amisulpride treatment response.
Nested case-control study within a birth cohort measures epigenome-wide DNA methylation mediating the association between urinary copper exposure and gestational diabetes.
TGM2/NR3C1 study analyzes TCGA gene expression and confirms transcription-factor binding by ChIP-qPCR only in LUSC cell lines, not a marker measured in patients.
Case-control study of 136 COPD patients versus 64 controls directly measures global DNA methylation as a candidate epigenetic biomarker linked to smoking and disease status.

The abstract does not settle whether the NE phenotype used for this cohort was actually derived from chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (an eligible marker) or from RNA sequencing gene expression in this specific study.
Retrospective comparison of venetoclax+hypomethylating agents versus priming regimens in AML-MR evaluates treatment efficacy without measuring any methylation biomarker.
Beyond the enzymatic-versus-bisulfite methodology comparison, the study reports a clinical finding linking IL-15 methylation to acalabrutinib response in the ACE-CL-001 CLL trial cohort.
Cohort of 111 JMML children and 9 controls directly measures BMP4 promoter methylation by targeted bisulfite sequencing for diagnostic and prognostic risk stratification.

Despite an apparently mismatched methods paragraph, the core case-control study of 25 cancer patients versus 25 controls directly measures p16 promoter hypermethylation linked to cadmium/chromium exposure.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial (VCSIP) measures buccal DNA methylation at asthma/allergy CpGs in children of pregnant smokers given vitamin C.
Next Generation birth cohort performs epigenome-wide cord-blood DNA methylation analysis comparing offspring exposed in-utero to maternal T2D versus GDM.
Diagnostic cohort of 62 individuals evaluates DNA methylation episignature arrays as a first-tier test for suspected genetic disorders.
PhenoAgeAccel here is computed from clinical chemistry biomarkers via linear regression, not from DNA methylation data, so no epigenetic marker is measured.
Three-cohort study of urine extracellular vesicle DNA directly measures methylation at prostate-cancer-specific loci to build a diagnostic and classification panel.
Intrinsic capacity age model is built from cognitive, sensory, vitality and locomotion biomarkers, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic measure.
Framingham cohort links immune-cell phenotypes and inflammatory proteins to DNA methylation aging clocks, but neither a modifiable exposure/intervention nor a clinical decision is being evaluated.
Cohort of 99 gastric cancer patients on anti-PD-1 therapy uses genome-wide methylation array/targeted sequencing to build the iMETH classifier predicting treatment response.
Population-based cohort of 182 Brazilian paediatric CNS tumours applies Infinium MethylationEPIC profiling for molecular diagnostic classification.

The abstract does not state whether DNA methylation at the KCNQ1OT1:TSS-DMR was directly measured in this cohort or whether BWS status was established by prior clinical testing before this placental-pathology analysis.

Multicentre ECCC study with sequencing and TMA validation cohorts directly measures whole-genome DNA methylation, linking hypermethylation at ETS1 sites to an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment and metastatic risk.
Pooled observational case-control analysis (5386 cases/6798 controls) measures CpG island methylator phenotype status and relates it to physical activity, a modifiable exposure.
Study measures gene expression of RNA m5C regulators (writers/erasers/readers) in adipose tissue, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state.
Mendelian randomization/machine-learning analysis of IBD draws on summary-level GWAS data (Fenland, FinnGen, Pan-UKB, IIBDGC) with no individual-level data analysed.
Biological age of heart/liver/kidney is calculated by the Klemera-Doubal method from dietary and clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
NRF2-TAGLN mechanism is studied entirely in ovarian cancer cell lines with no human participant or human-derived sample.
Training and validation urine sample sets directly measure Vimentin/POU4F2 methylation by RT-PCR for non-invasive bladder carcinoma diagnosis.
Case-control study of 150 cancer patients versus 150 controls directly measures global 5-methylcytosine DNA methylation by ELISA alongside piRNA levels, so ncRNA is not the only marker measured.
Fourteen dystonia cases with unresolved variants were selected from a larger cohort for long-read sequencing with no stated comparison group, a case series.
This is a clinical practice guideline built on systematic reviews of randomised controlled trials, not a primary study itself.
Cohort comparing WTC-exposed and unexposed women profiles blood DNA methylation with four epigenetic clocks to test association with WTC environmental exposure.

The abstract references molecular ependymoma subgroups (EPN-PFA/PFB/ZFTA/YAP1) without stating that DNA methylation profiling, rather than another platform, was the measurement used to define them in this cohort.
CHAMACOS cohort repeatedly measures DNA methylation from birth to age 18 to derive cumulative epigenetic aging and its prospective association with cardiometabolic health.
Cross-sectional MIDUS study measures DunedinPACE and GrimAge2 DNA methylation clocks and relates them to relationship-stress domains.
Case-control FTD cohort (27 carriers, 250 non-carriers) performs genome-wide DNA methylation analysis to build and validate a diagnostic predictor of C9orf72 repeat expansion.
Longitudinal cohort of 216 people with HIV measures blood DNA methylation across eight epigenetic clocks and tests prognostic association with AIDS, SNAEs, and mortality.
PhenoAge-accel is explicitly defined here from immune/inflammatory clinical markers compared to chronological age, not from DNA methylation.
The abstract reports sensitivity/specificity for a 56-sample ovarian cancer cohort without stating what comparison group, if any, the ROC analysis was performed against.
Cohort of adult IBD patients and controls, replicated in two independent cohorts, measures blood DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and disease-progression-associated CpGs.
Citrullinated histone H3-DNA (CitH3-DNA) complexes are quantified by ELISA as a circulating NETosis marker, explicitly a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Histone H4 is measured as a circulating serum/urine protein biomarker by ELISA, not as a chromatin modification.
Study directly measures whole-genome abnormal DNA methylation in cfDNA from esophageal squamous cell carcinoma patients to detect ctDNA for early cancer diagnosis.
Case-control comparison of glioma patients and age-matched controls directly measures LINE-1 methylation and H4K20me3/H3K9me3 histone marks in plasma cfDNA and tissue, linked to prognosis.
Two-sample Mendelian randomization across GWAS/eQTL summary statistics identifies ageing-related genes, validated only in mouse experiments, with no individual-level human data analysed.
A case-control study validates the bisulfite-free dRE-STEM cfDNA methylation method against CRC-specific loci in human plasma samples for diagnostic screening.
MGMT inhibition and gamma-H2AX induction are demonstrated in glioblastoma cell culture and a patient-derived xenograft mouse model, with no human participant measurement.
Biological age is derived from clinical measures via the Klemera-Doubal method and Mahalanobis distance, not DNA methylation.
Multicentre AIN3 cohort followed for 3+ years directly measures ZNF582/ASCL1 methylation on anal smears to predict progression to anal cancer.
Multicentre prospective study directly measures aberrant DNA methylation (HIST1H4F, NRN1, POU4F2) in urine alongside mutations to diagnose urothelial carcinoma.
Cross-sectional MIDUS study relates neighborhood opportunity, a modifiable social exposure, to three DNA methylation-based epigenetic clock measures.
Study genotypes IDH1/IDH2 mutations in AML patients; the resulting histone/DNA hypermethylation is discussed but not itself measured.
Retrospective cohort of 206 recurrent glioblastoma patients incorporates measured MGMT promoter methylation status into a prognostic nomogram.
Health and Retirement Study cohort develops a DNA methylation surrogate biomarker for chronic inflammation and validates its prognostic value for mortality and multimorbidity.
Cross-sectional case-control study of 58 JIA patients versus 35 controls directly measures 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine levels as diagnostic biomarkers.
Longitudinal single-arm study of 122 healthy adults measures SLC6A4 promoter methylation before and after an acute stress test, correlated with cortisol reactivity.
Case-control study genotypes TRDMT1 polymorphisms by TaqMan assay, a genetic association study that does not directly measure any epigenetic mark.
Reference cohort of 2540 samples plus retrospective and real-time validation cohorts uses genome-wide DNA methylation profiling to classify acute leukemia diagnostically.
Longitudinal bone-density study of childhood gymnastics participation measures pQCT bone parameters, with no epigenetic marker.
N7-methylguanine, despite being labelled a 'DNA methylation biomarker' here, is a DNA alkylation-damage adduct rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Nationwide French JMML cohort reports that a low DNA methylation profile is associated with favorable watch-and-wait outcomes in NRAS-mutated cases.
H3Cit-DNA complexes are measured in plasma as a NET biomarker of neutrophil activation, a circulating protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.

Nrf2 promoter methylation by bisulfite sequencing appears to have been assessed only in CSE-treated bronchial epithelial cells in vitro; human tissue analysis was limited to protein levels by Western blot.
Retrospective cohort of 62 endometrial neoplasia patients treated with MPA performs DNA methylation microarray analysis to identify methylomic subtypes predicting treatment efficacy.
Biological aging acceleration is assessed via Klemera-Doubal and PhenoAge algorithms based on clinical measures, not DNA methylation, in this kidney stone cohort.
Case-control comparison of 16 children across obesity/birth-weight groups performs an epigenome-wide association study directly measuring global DNA methylation.
Retrospective imaging review of 8 pediatric H3K27M/BRAF V600E co-mutated midline glioma cases has no stated comparison group, a case series.
Two independent tissue/plasma cohorts plus a 114-patient longitudinal cohort directly measure MIR129-2 promoter methylation via ctDNA qPCR to predict PDAC recurrence.

The NHANES component analyzes clinical-biomarker-based PhenoAge, and the DNAm clock components are examined only via GWAS summary-statistic Mendelian randomization, not by measuring methylation in these participants.
PhenoAge here is used as a biological-age comparator for frailty/disability in spinal deformity patients with no indication it is DNA methylation-derived in this study.
GUSTO cohort measures a smoking-associated DNA methylation risk score in umbilical cord tissue and relates it to offspring caries experience.
Twin study (310 discovery, 777 replication) measures eight DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and methylation-based telomere length, relating them to incident fracture and osteoporosis.
Case-control validation in 48 HNSCC versus 46 control tissue samples directly measures DNA methylation to design and test clinically applicable MSP biomarker assays.
Finnish Twin Cohort study profiles DNA methylation at CpG sites associated with both stressful life events and breast cancer risk in a 36-year prospective cohort.
All nine biological age measures in this cardiovascular mortality study are built from clinical indices, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker involved.
Queensland Flood Study cohort measures placental DNA methylation via the EPIC array and relates epigenetic age acceleration to prenatal maternal stress exposure.
Longitudinal Hispanic Community Health Study cohort measures blood DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks at two visits and relates change to cognitive aging outcomes.
Biological age deep-learning model is trained on routine clinical checkup parameters and comorbidity/mortality data, with no DNA methylation or epigenetic measure.
